theorems.name: Submission.iwl_cr_hp_injective_pieces
theorems.statement: ∀ (P m : ℕ) (A : Set (Eucl P)), MeasurableSet A → CountablyRectifiable m A → ∃ (G : ℕ → Eucl m → Eucl P) (B : ℕ → Set (Eucl m)), (∀ p, ∃ K : ℝ≥0, LipschitzWith K (G p)) ∧ (∀ p, MeasurableSet (B p)) ∧ (∀ p, InjOn (G p) (B p)) ∧ (∀ p, ∀ b ∈ B p, DifferentiableAt ℝ (G p) b) ∧ (∀ p, G p '' B p ⊆ A) ∧ (∀ p, MeasurableSet (G p '' B p)) ∧ Pairwise (Function.onFun Disjoint fun p => G p '' B p) ∧ (μHE[m] : Measure (Eucl P)) (A \ ⋃ p, G p '' B p) = 0
